product_one_liner.value: koppla is a collaborative construction scheduling platform that helps construction companies, project managers and site teams plan, coordinate and monitor projects together.

pricing_page.notes: Public project and enterprise licence plans; prices are provided by individual quotation.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies Berlin as headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The blog covers construction, scheduling, company news and product education rather than engineering implementation.

public_docs.notes: Public help articles cover project imports and API usage, among other product topics.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists Founders Associate – GTM / RevOps / Growth and Senior Product Engineer – Coding & People Leadership; neither is a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No named model or provider found in the public AI/product pages, import/API documentation, blog, Trust Center or linked privacy notices; no public subprocessor list identifying one was located.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists ISO/IEC 27001 and GDPR. GDPR is a regulatory compliance claim, not an independent certification.

last_funding.notes: CB Insights labels the round Seed VC - III and reports $6.76 million on 2025-05-19; the company announcement reports €6 million. USD amount is the database-reported figure, not a calculated conversion.

raised_18mo.notes: The May 2025 financing falls within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No qualifying SDR, BDR or account executive title appears on the live board; older recruiting announcements are not treated as current openings.

launched_6mo.notes: A new BIM integration was announced on 2026-05-27, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying dated appointment or departure was verified. The about page does not provide a complete leadership roster with start dates; the VP Revenue profile gives September 2025, outside the window, but does not establish the absence of other leadership changes.

crm_stack_signal.notes: An archived account-executive posting explicitly says the team works with HubSpot. The company profile also lists HubSpot Sales, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Hunter and Segment; these are visible stack signals, not proof that every system remains in use.
